svg.title: ObjDec: object-guided shared and modality-specific representation learning
svg.desc: Real K-Radar inputs and ObjDec outputs: seq22_rdr00484. The input token maps independently into two representation branches. Response and control glyphs are conceptual. Radar fan: max sparse xyz-power in range-azimuth bins, not raw dense spectrum.
svg.text: K-Radar: S22 / radar 00484 | Real ObjDec predictions: score > 0.3
